value.sql:
SELECT
  customer_key,
  gender,
  continent
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer
value.means: One row per person on Contoso's customer register — 104,990 of them, carrying each person's recorded gender and the continent they live on. This is everyone on record, not the buyer list: it includes the 52,801 who have never appeared on a sale, and it is not restricted by any date, because a register row is a standing fact and not an event.
